topic.title: Preface
topic.shortdesc: Welcome to the comprehensive test publication for the DITA2ePub plugin. This document exercises all major DITA features to ensure proper EPUB3 transformation.

body.p: This test publication has been created to thoroughly validate the DITA2ePub plugin's ability to transform DITA content into high-quality EPUB3 publications.

section.title: Purpose of This Document
section.p: The primary purposes of this comprehensive test are:

ul.li: Validate all DITA element transformations to EPUB3/HTML5
Verify metadata extraction from DITA bookmeta
Ensure accessibility features are properly implemented
Confirm proper handling of images, tables, and multimedia

section.title: Structure of This Document
section.p: This publication is organized into three main chapters:

dlentry.dd: Covers fundamental DITA elements like paragraphs, lists, tables, and images.
Explores complex features including notes, code samples, links, and structural elements.
Demonstrates specialized topic types and content patterns.

ol.li: Transform this DITA map to EPUB3 using the DITA2ePub plugin
Validate the resulting EPUB with EPUBCheck
Open the EPUB in multiple readers (Calibre, Adobe Digital Editions, iBooks)
Check accessibility features with screen readers

body.note: All content in this test publication is for testing purposes only and does not represent actual documentation.
